# AltaCV

- Source: https://github.com/liantze/AltaCV (`altacv.cls` v1.7.4 and `sample.tex`, fetched
  2026-11-01 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liantze/AltaCV/main/)
- Licence: LaTeX Project Public License 1.3 or later, as stated in the header of `altacv.cls`.
  The work order listed AltaCV as MIT; the class file says LPPL, and the repository has no
  separate licence file. LPPL permits redistribution of unmodified files; `original/` holds them
  unmodified.
- `template.tex`: header block added; class options, packages, fonts, colours and the two-column
  paracol layout are the sample's. Removed as sample-only content with no profile equivalent:
  the photo, publications (bibliography setup and `\printbibliography`), quote, achievements,
  languages, referees and wheel chart. Contact links use `\homepage`, because the profile stores
  full links rather than GitHub/LinkedIn ids.
